title: xantholinum flavum
intro: Xantholinum flavum, commonly known as Yellow Honeysuckle, is a flowering plant species in the family Apocynaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestive health. The therapeutic actions of Xantholinum flavum include its antispasmodic and antitussive properties, making it a potential treatment for coughs and respiratory issues.
